environment.description: Service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, Go 1.22) with a public Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions. The service is directly reachable from the internet.

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, SG ingress 0.0.0.0/0:8080
